_comment_instructions: This file contains settings for name corrections and AI trigger words. You can edit this file to suite your needs.
_comment_regex_help: Trigger patterns use Regular Expressions (Regex), matched case-insensitively. '[^a-zA-Z]{0,2}' means up to two non-letter characters (spaces, dots, hyphens, commas). '(?:eye|i)' matches the letter 'i' or the phonetic spelling 'eye'. So 'prompt[^a-zA-Z]{0,2}a[^a-zA-Z]{0,2}(?:eye|i)' matches 'promptai', 'prompt ai', 'prompt a.i.', 'prompt A-I', 'prompt a eye', and 'prompt A. Eye'. Raise the '2' to allow more spacing.
_comment_roast_mode: roast_trigger_patterns is the shared 'mean mode'. 'prompt roast', 'prompt tiktok' (also transcribed as 'tick tock'), and 'prompt disses' all route to the same social-media-tuned rewriter that weaves in a matching line from insults_file_path. It is checked BEFORE the normal trigger_patterns.
